name: blameless-postmortem
description: Write blameless incident postmortems per Google's Site Reliability Engineering practice (SRE Book ch. 15 "Postmortem Culture" and its Example Postmortem; SRE Workbook ch. 10). Use when the user writes a postmortem, incident report, incident review, outage write-up, root cause analysis (RCA), or "lessons learned" after downtime, data loss, a rollback, or a missed alert.
